reason: When I need a website I ring three local firms, get three quotes and go with the middle one. A lone freelancer in Kuwait with no UK clients or reviews wouldn't make my shortlist, even with pay-when-happy.
objection: With 30-odd staff I can't take a punt on someone with no UK track record, in a different time zone, and I don't have time to chase him on WhatsApp if something breaks.
would_change_my_mind: A few reviews from Manchester businesses my size that I could ring, plus a fixed quote I can put next to two local ones without having to get on a call.
